title: Daddy's Movie Camera
hook: 邮递员送来一台会说话的摄影机，佩奇和乔治各拍了一部小电影，乔治被自己拍的恐龙吓到了。

cells.a: Mr. Zebra the postman is delivering a parcel to their house.
cells.cn: 邮递员斑马先生送来一个包裹。

cells.q: What did they say about the parcel?
cells.a: They said it is far too small to have a dinosaur inside.
cells.cn: 他们说包裹太小，里面装不下恐龙。

cells.a: It is a movie camera, just like Suzy Sheep's mummy has.
cells.cn: 是一台摄影机，和苏西妈妈的同款。

cells.q: What did they want to do with the camera?
cells.a: They wanted to turn the talking voice off.
cells.cn: 他们想把那说话的提示音关掉。

cells.a: He asked what he shall film first with the camera.

cells.q: What did they decide to do?
cells.a: They decided that everyone must do something for the film.
cells.cn: 他们决定每个人都要为电影演点什么。

cells.q: What did George and Peppa make?
cells.a: They each made a little movie of their own.
cells.cn: 他们各自拍了一部小电影。

cells.a: He sees a dinosaur on TV and thinks it is real.
cells.cn: 他在电视里看到恐龙，以为是真的。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig say on the film?
cells.a: He said his tummy is big because he eats lots of cookies.
cells.cn: 他在片子里说自己肚子大是因为吃了很多饼干。
